g.text: Whole-file rates except Normal estimate • Parking rows show active recording only
256 GB hours = nominal capacity / rate. No formatting, reserved space or protected-file allowance.
Parking capacity is recorded-footage hours, NOT elapsed parked time. Auto Event duty cycle is unknown.
Normal is video-only (hatched). Auto Event uses typical 45-second paired clips normalized to one minute.
